column7: DeleteSecret did not close approved secret-scoped AccessRequests, so the restricted-read approval (core.hasApprovedSecretAccessRequest) revived on RestoreSecret with no re-authorization. DeleteSecret and deleteProjectCascade now move those requests to expired and stamp resolved_at in the delete transaction; DeleteResolvedAccessRequestsBefore retention still applies (TestDeleteSecret_ClosedAccessRequestFollowsResolvedRetention). Project-cascade variant: TestDeleteProjectCascade_ClosesApprovedSecretAccessRequests_NotRevivedByRestoreProject.
